subject: Exec retreat — privacy rooming & access routing
messages:
From: Olivia Benson <olivia.benson@willowtravel.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec retreat — privacy rooms & access routing

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the initial brief. A couple of items for the hotel-side team so we can ensure the group has the privacy profile you asked for: 

- We can hold two executive floors (12 rooms each) on a tentative basis. We can route a private elevator/staff if you want a fully discrete arrival for the execs.
- Keycards: provisioning takes 48–72 hours from confirmed roster; we can pre-program VIP access paths for the two floors and meeting suite.
- Masterbill: the hotel can split charges into multiple masterbill lines (Redwood main + partner org) but we need billing codes at least 10 days prior to arrival.

Action items we need from you by EOD Tue, Aug 3: final roster (name, preferred room type, single vs. double occupancy, accessibility needs), and a single primary billing contact for masterbill routing.

Attached: preliminary rooming template (CSV) and a quick site map.

Thanks,
Olivia Benson
Senior Events Manager, Willow Travel (on assignment with Copper Hotels)
attachment: preliminary_rooming_template.csv (text/csv)
attachment: venue_quickmap.pdf (application/pdf)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Benson <olivia.benson@willowtravel.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec retreat — privacy rooms & access routing

Olivia — thanks for the clear rundown. Quick clarifications so we can populate the roster: 

1) Single-occupancy default. We will only request doubles in very rare cases (execs bringing family). Can you reserve an additional 6 single-occupancy fallback rooms adjacent to the executive floors?
2) Connecting rooms: a few directors prefer an adjoining room for EA support — can you flag which rooms on the floor plan are connectable?
3) Accessibility: one attendee (name on roster to follow) requires roll-in shower + ground-floor access. Please mark the accessible inventory.
4) Masterbill split: we want Redwood charges on one line and guest incidental guarantees on a second. Who should we list as the billing contact at the hotel (name + email)?

I've attached our updated rooming sheet (rooming_preferences_v3.csv) with tentative seat assignments and dietary notes. Please don't finalize keycards until we sign off on final roster.

Appreciate it —
Jonas
VP, Customer Programs — Redwood Inference
attachment: rooming_preferences_v3.csv (text/csv)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@copperhotels.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec retreat — privacy rooms & access routing

Jonas / team —Super. We can support the requests. A few specifics and options: 

- Floor assignments: we can hold floors 10–11 as the ‘exec cluster’ and keep floors 12–13 as overflow; connecting room flags are included in the attached site map (site_access_map.pdf).
- Private arrival: we can block a discrete elevator bank from 6:30–9:30 AM on event days, and station concierge staff at a non-public entrance. This is an add-on service (USD 950/day) — let us know if Redwood covers that.
- Accessibility: we have two ADA rooms on the service level with ramped access; we'll mark them in the CSV and reserve until Aug 2.
- Keycards: once roster is final, we need a 72-hour lead to program VIP paths; we can also provision temporary day cards for vendor partners if needed.
- Billing: to split a masterbill we need purchase order or billing code; our finance contact is Hannah Rios (h.rios@copperhotels.com). Please provide PO or billing codes at least 10 days before arrival.

Cost notes (per night, per room): Exec King (single) USD 420; Exec Junior Suite USD 650. Private elevator add-on listed above.

Link: site map + back-of-house routing (attached).

On logistics deadlines: final roster by 2026-08-02; masterbill codes and PO by 2026-07-30. If you expect headcount churn after the roster close we can hold 6 rooms in a soft block with release 5 days prior.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Regional Sales Director — Copper Hotels
attachment: site_access_map.pdf (application/pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Benson <olivia.benson@willowtravel.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@copperhotels.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Exec retreat — privacy rooms & access routing

Couple of internal notes before we reply to Samir: 

- Priority for single-occupancy: C-suite & board (20 rooms). Directors (6) can be on overflow but prefer connectable rooms when possible.
- Accessibility: Priyom, can you confirm the attendee name and arrival/departure windows so we can lock the ADA room?
- Dietary / room amenities: Laura — please consolidate any late-night dietary restrictions (kosher / halal / severe allergies) into the CSV under the dietary column.
- Masterbill: we will route core charges to Redwood; partner reimbursements (travel stipends) to be on a second line — finance wants a PO number if possible.

(Quoted for context)
> On Fri, Jul 24, 2026 at 08:32 AM Samir Patel <samir.patel@copperhotels.com> wrote:
> > We can block floors 10–11 as the ‘exec cluster’ and keep floors 12–13 as overflow; connecting room flags are included in the attached site map.

I'll draft a short reply confirming dates and asking for Hannah Rios as the billing contact.

-Marissa

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Benson <olivia.benson@willowtravel.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@copperhotels.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec retreat — privacy rooms & access routing — final roster attached

Marissa / team / Samir / Olivia — attaching the finalized roster for the block. Changes from v3: swapped two directors to adjacent connectable rooms, confirmed one ADA room (A. Kumar), and moved three attendees from double to single occupancy.

Attached: rooming_preferences_v4_final.csv (see CSV).

Questions for Samir / Olivia: 
- Please confirm Hannah Rios (h.rios@copperhotels.com) as the hotel billing contact and whether Copper needs a PO for the split masterbill (we can push PO request internally).
- Can the hotel hold the private elevator add-on as a soft hold until Aug 5 pending budget signoff?

If you confirm those two items I will mark the roster as final and we can author the keycards (72-hour window).

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Events Operations — Redwood Inference
attachment: rooming_preferences_v4_final.csv (text/csv)
